name: centry-global-pension-planner
description:
Create an international pension inventory with native-currency balances, separately labelled income entitlements, disclosed fees, source-linked scheme terms, evidence gaps and a decision timeline. Prepare questions for pension providers and qualified specialists; no transfer recommendation or tax opinion.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Entered fee arithmetic is not corroboration or transfer advice. No eligibility, access-age, tax or suitability conclusion. Centry does not provide US tax advice. Scheme terms are extracted from supplied text only; no external account access, verified provider coverage, automatic eligibility or transfer execution. Disclosed-cost arithmetic does not establish suitability or tax efficiency. Pot values, income entitlements and currencies are kept separate. No tax, treaty or pension benefit calculation; Centry does not provide US tax advice. Unknown, tiered, performance-based and underlying fund charges require confirmation; no guessed zero fees.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Global Pension Planner: Create an international pension inventory with native-currency balances, separately labelled income entitlements, disclosed fees, source-linked scheme terms, evidence gaps and a decision timeline. Prepare questions for pension providers and qualified specialists; no transfer recommendation or tax opinion. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports.
